description:
We look for software professionals, experienced in requirements analysis and MS SQL development, to join our team in Bucharest on permanent basis.

Requirements:
• Experience in design, development and programming of products in MS SQL.
• Oracle, MySQL or Java experience is a plus.
• Strong analytical skills
• Experience in Data Modelling (creation of tables, indexes, foreign keys)
• MS SQL database administration and optimization experience would be a great advantage
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or Cybernetics is a plus
• Understanding and observing the working methods and practices in SW development process - design, code writing, testing and documentation writing
• Good communication skills and a team player

Job description
• Understand and analyze the business requirements, generate the “business logic”
• Design database structure and SQL programming
• Generate optimization strategies and implement them for the current databases
• Propose new technologies and/or solutions to our challenges.

We offer:
• Competitive salary package
• Career development opportunities
• Professional and friendly working environment
• Centrally located location

About us:
WESTACO is involved in complex HW and SW projects. Our team designs, develops and maintains complex SW applications, mainly on client-server architecture, for our own needs and local or international partners.
